1	import { z } from 'zod';
     2	import { SLUG_REGEX } from './knowledge.js';
     3	
     4	/**
     5	 * Three-horizon strategic vision for a repository.
     6	 *
     7	 * All three horizon fields are nullable strings — `null` indicates the vision
     8	 * has not yet been authored for that horizon. Empty strings are rejected to
     9	 * prevent accidentally saving a "blank" vision that is visually
    10	 * indistinguishable from an unset one.
    11	 */
    12	export const StrategicVisionSchema = z.object({
    13	  short_term: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
    14	  mid_term: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
    15	  long_term: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
    16	});
    17	export type StrategicVision = z.infer<typeof StrategicVisionSchema>;
    18	
    19	/**
    20	 * A single repository entry in the central `.repositories.json` registry.
    21	 *
    22	 * Field notes:
    23	 * - `id`: slug identifier for this entry, validated against SLUG_REGEX.
    24	 *   Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only letters,
    25	 *   digits, hyphens, and underscores. This prevents path traversal and
    26	 *   ensures it is safe to use as a filename fragment.
    27	 * - `label`: human-readable display name shown in the GUI Strategy screen.
    28	 * - `folder_names`: one or more workspace folder names that map to this
    29	 *   repository entry. The storage layer uses these aliases to resolve
    30	 *   `ledger_get_repository_context` lookups by the active workspace folder.
    31	 * - `vision`: three-horizon strategic vision, or all-null if not yet authored.
    32	 * - `created_at`: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the entry was first created.
    33	 * - `last_modified`: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent edit.
    34	 */
    35	export const RepositoryEntrySchema = z.object({
    36	  id: z.string().regex(SLUG_REGEX),
    37	  label: z.string().min(1),
    38	  folder_names: z.array(z.string().min(1)).min(1),
    39	  vision: StrategicVisionSchema,
    40	  created_at: z.string(),
    41	  last_modified: z.string(),
    42	});
    43	export type RepositoryEntry = z.infer<typeof RepositoryEntrySchema>;
    44	
    45	/**
    46	 * Top-level schema for the `.repositories.json` registry file.
    47	 *
    48	 * The registry is stored at `{ledgerRoot}/.repositories.json` and lists
    49	 * all opt-in repository entries. An empty `repositories` array is valid
    50	 * and represents a registry that has been initialized but not yet populated.
    51	 */
    52	export const RepositoryRegistrySchema = z.object({
    53	  repositories: z.array(RepositoryEntrySchema),
    54	});
    55	export type RepositoryRegistry = z.infer<typeof RepositoryRegistrySchema>;

1	import { z } from 'zod';
     2	
     3	/**
     4	 * Insight scope enum.
     5	 * - 'global'     — applies across all codebases / repositories
     6	 * - 'repository' — scoped to a specific repository (codebase-level knowledge)
     7	 *
     8	 * Note: when scope === 'repository', repository_name should be present. This
     9	 * constraint is enforced by the storage layer rather than this schema, so the
    10	 * Zod schema remains composable and usable without runtime context.
    11	 */
    12	export const InsightScope = z.enum(['global', 'repository']);
    13	export type InsightScope = z.infer<typeof InsightScope>;
    14	
    15	/**
    16	 * Regex pattern for valid slugs (repository names, plan slugs, etc.).
    17	 *
    18	 * Accepts slugs that start with an alphanumeric character and contain only
    19	 * letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. Rejects anything with `/`, `\`,
    20	 * `.`, spaces, or other characters that could escape the `.knowledge/` directory.
    21	 *
    22	 * This pattern is the single source of truth — used by the Zod schema
    23	 * (InsightSchema.repository_name, InsightSchema.origin_plan) and the
    24	 * storage-layer guard (_validateSlug).
    25	 * Update this constant to change the slug policy in both places at once.
    26	 */
    27	export const SLUG_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$/;
    28	
    29	/**
    30	 * Insight schema — a single reusable knowledge record stored in the knowledge base.
    31	 *
    32	 * Field notes:
    33	 * - `repository_name`: required when scope === 'repository', but that constraint
    34	 *   is owned by the storage layer (KnowledgeStoreManager), not this schema. The
    35	 *   schema accepts repository_name as optional to remain context-free. The regex
    36	 *   constraint (SLUG_REGEX: `^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$`) prevents
    37	 *   path traversal at the schema boundary — slugs with `/`, `\`, or `..` are
    38	 *   rejected.
    39	 * - `origin_plan`: optional provenance metadata — the plan slug where this
    40	 *   insight was first discovered or generated. Validated against SLUG_REGEX.
    41	 *   Distinct from `source` (a reference link/URL); origin_plan records the
    42	 *   planning artefact that produced the insight.
    43	 * - `confidence`: a 0–1 float indicating reliability of the insight. Range is
    44	 *   enforced as [0, 1] — values outside this range are rejected at parse time.
    45	 * - `superseded_by`: optional reference to the id of the insight that replaces
    46	 *   this one. No referential integrity is enforced at the schema layer.
    47	 * - `updated_at`: optional; present only when an insight has been amended after
    48	 *   initial creation.
    49	 */
    50	export const InsightSchema = z.object({
    51	  id: z.number().int(),
    52	  scope: InsightScope,
    53	  repository_name: z.string().regex(SLUG_REGEX).optional(),
    54	  origin_plan: z.string().regex(SLUG_REGEX).optional(),
    55	  title: z.string(),
    56	  content: z.string(),
    57	  category: z.string(),
    58	  tags: z.array(z.string()),
    59	  source: z.string(),
    60	  created_at: z.string(),
    61	  updated_at: z.string().optional(),
    62	  confidence: z.number().min(0).max(1),
    63	  superseded_by: z.number().int().optional(),
    64	});
    65	export type Insight = z.infer<typeof InsightSchema>;
    66	
    67	/**
    68	 * KnowledgeStore schema — top-level structure for per-scope store files under `.knowledge/`.
    69	 *
    70	 * The knowledge base uses a multi-file layout — one JSON file per store:
    71	 * - `.knowledge/global-insights.json` — global-scoped insights
    72	 * - `.knowledge/{repositoryName}-insights.json` — repository-scoped insights
    73	 *
    74	 * Each file conforms to this schema:
    75	 * - `version`: schema version string (e.g. "1.0.0") for forward-compatibility.
    76	 * - `last_updated`: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent write.
    77	 * - `next_id`: auto-increment counter; the id that will be assigned to the
    78	 *   next insight added to this store.
    79	 * - `insights`: flat array of all stored Insight records in this store.
    80	 */
    81	export const KnowledgeStoreSchema = z.object({
    82	  version: z.string(),
    83	  last_updated: z.string(),
    84	  next_id: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
    85	  insights: z.array(InsightSchema),
    86	});
    87	export type KnowledgeStore = z.infer<typeof KnowledgeStoreSchema>;
